frontmatter.title: Amplitude estimation
frontmatter.description: Explicit threshold counting, phase-estimation circuits, independent checks and conditional surface-code costs.

children.value: Amplitude estimation turns a flag’s probability into a coherent circuit’s rotation angle. Instead of observing the flag repeatedly, the fundamental algorithm applies controlled amplification steps and estimates their eigenphases
. This is useful when sample preparation or predicate evaluation is expensive and coherent access and inverse access are available. Those operations are explicit parts of the circuit here.

Standard phase-estimation amplitude estimation, preparation/inverse preparation, a threshold predicate, both reflections, complete controlled powers, final measurements, and an ideal median-confidence contract are implemented. Bounded circuits and their primitive lowering are checked against independent analytic distributions; a separately labeled classical categorical experiment checks median coverage.
. There is no generated Clifford+T synthesis certificate or hardware amplitude-confidence guarantee. A separate
implements fresh sampled batches and exact conservative interval arithmetic. Practical application predicates and formal Lean coverage remain planned.

Factory allocation and code distance can differ between independently selected points, so peak qubits need not grow monotonically across this table. In particular, the one-data-bit fastest point spends more qubits for a short runtime; its smallest-qubit alternative has 11,060 physical qubits and runtime 0.074925 s. Additional rows are computed resource models, not additional statevector or device experiments. These bounded samples supply no physical asymptotic complexity or advantage theorem.

Data width is capped at 20, phase width at ten and repeated source instructions at 250,000; the shared QPE builder also applies its 200,000 source-instruction cap. These source counts treat each MCX atomically. Primitive export is capped at 250,000 after lowering; controlled-gate compilation can consume extra work before that final guard.
